tooltips.metaSystemUserId: App-scoped ID of the Meta System User this token belongs to. Populated automatically from the token when available.
tooltips.metaBusinessId: Optional Business Manager (portfolio) ID that owns this System User. Used for diagnostics and asset-scoped Graph API calls.
tooltips.metaTokenInfo: Diagnostic information returned by Meta's /debug_token endpoint when the System User token was set (app id, scopes, expiry). Read-only.
tooltips.whatsappBusinessAccountId: WABA ID captured from the Embedded Signup popup. Read-only.
tooltips.whatsappPhoneNumberId: Phone Number ID captured from the Embedded Signup popup. Read-only.
tooltips.whatsappOnboardingType: Type of WhatsApp onboarding completed in the Embedded Signup popup.
tooltips.whatsappCoexistenceSyncedAt: When the contacts + history sync (POST /smb_app_data) completed. Empty for non-Coexistence accounts. The sync has a 24-hour deadline after onboarding.
tooltips.agentEgress: When enabled, agentbox receives high-entropy placeholders instead of real OAuth tokens. The egress proxy substitutes the real value only for allowlisted hosts.

labels.agentEgressSecrets: Secrets exposed to the agent (one row per env var)
labels.agentEgressReplaceInQuery: Also replace in URL query string

messages.confirmSetSystemUserToken: Paste the Meta System User access token. It will be validated against the Graph API and stored encrypted.
messages.systemUserTokenSet: System User token validated and stored.
messages.systemUserTokenFailed: Could not validate or store the System User token.
messages.systemUserMissingClientId: Set the Client ID (App ID) and Client Secret on the Meta (System User) provider before setting a token.
messages.systemUserTokenMissingScopes: Token saved, but it is missing scopes: {scopes}. WhatsApp/Business features may not work until you regenerate the token with these scopes.
messages.agentEgressHelp: Guest agents never see real tokens. Add one row per env var (e.g. ACCESS_TOKEN). Placeholders are swapped by the egress proxy only for allowed hosts.
messages.agentEgressPlaceholderModeHelp: Shared marker is easiest to recognize in logs as placeholders. Unique mode uses a fully random string per secret.
messages.agentEgressConfigPathHelp: Dot path into this OAuth account (e.g. accessToken, refreshToken, data.someKey). Only those roots are allowed. Tokens are resolved live on save and at agent spawn — never returned on normal GET.
messages.agentEgressHostsHelp: Comma-separated host patterns. Supports * wildcards (e.g. graph.microsoft.com, *.googleapis.com).
messages.agentEgressReplaceInQueryHelp: Off by default. Only enable if the target API requires the secret in the query string (prefer headers).
messages.agentEgressRequiresSecret: Add at least one secret when injection is enabled
messages.agentEgressInvalidEnvName: Use an uppercase env name (A–Z, 0–9, _). e.g. ACCESS_TOKEN
messages.agentEgressDuplicateEnvName: Env variable name must be unique
messages.agentEgressInvalidConfigPath: Invalid path format. Use dot segments like accessToken or data.someKey.
messages.agentEgressInvalidOAuthConfigPath: Path must be accessToken, access_token, refreshToken, refresh_token, or data.<key>.
messages.agentEgressHostsRequired: At least one allowed host is required
